description: Claude's narration between steps (summarized thinking): a sentence or two shown in the conversation as ordinary markdown, dimmed. It is not folded away.
opens: A thinking block with words in it, live or from history

parts.name: text
parts.shows: Full column width, drawn as markdown (see Reply), the whole thing at 62% opacity. Links in it work as a reply's do.

states.name: streaming
states.shows: Appears only once its first words arrive, then grows like a reply.

states.name: empty / signed-only
states.shows: Thinking blocks with no words (the model's raw reasoning arrives as empty signed blocks) are never drawn.

states.name: between tool calls
states.shows: It stands on its own line in the chat and splits a run of tool calls: calls before and after it are grouped separately (ToolGroup).
